newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Kodak appoints new execs.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Kodak appoints new execs.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said on Monday that it had named Alain Joffrin, currently president and general manager of Kodak SA and Kodak-Pathe, as General Manager of its European, African and Middle Eastern Region.
Joffrin replaces Henri Petit, who was recently named a chief operating officer of Consumer Imaging, Kodak's largest business, the company said in a statement.

As a result of Joffrin's posting, Etienne Bourgeois, currently manufacturing manager of Kodak-Pathe, was appointed to take Joffrin's place as general manager of Kodak S.A., in addition to his current responsibilities, the company added.
Joffrin, 55, joined Kodak-Pathe in 1966 in the Export Trade division, the company said.
